method: Option A: mu from OD (mid->late) + q from mid->late window (arith-mean X); NH4 from image (T0->mid, arith-mean X)

EX_tybx_e.source: mid->late window, arith-mean X (single rep, sigma=20% CV)

EX_nh4_e.note: Biological cap: 2x canonical E. coli max NH4 uptake (~7 mmol/gDW/h). Model self-selects ~5-11. Cap ensures physical realism.

EX_fmd_e.note: Biological cap: ~10x biomass+product N-demand at mu=0.13, ~1/3 of the physical ceiling (5 mmol total / gDW-hr integral). Blocks the unrealistic formate-combustion pathway.
